turns.agent:
I hear your frustration, and I'm sorry you're dealing with this. You're right that this is urgent, especially after two days locked out.

Unfortunately, I don't have the ability to escalate to a chat supervisor or create a live transfer—that's not how our support system works. The escalation I created (ESC-3001) goes directly to our Account Access team, but they handle requests by phone.

I know that's not the instant chat support you're looking for, but calling with your reference number is genuinely your fastest solution.
